content:
WhatsApp users can now share longer music clips in Status updates, with the duration limit doubled to 30 seconds. Details as follows.

WhatsApp Status Music Clip Duration Increased to 30 Seconds

According to WABetaInfo, WhatsApp is rolling out a feature that supports up to 30 seconds of music clips in Status updates.

Status updates are a WhatsApp feature similar to Instagram Stories; previously, music-containing posts were limited to 15 seconds.

Now, users can select a segment of up to 30 seconds from a song and post it with an image, or share the music clip directly as a Status update.

Below is WABetaInfo's explanation on how to select music clip duration under the new 30-second limit:

As is typical with WhatsApp rolling out new features on the server side, the new 30-second limit is not yet available to all users. However, WABetaInfo notes that on both iOS and Android, some users have already seen the new limit. For iOS, the compatible update version listed by the site is WhatsApp 26.35.72.
